exposure: Intervention to lower cesarean delivery rates
outcome: Neonatal outcomes (hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy, meconium aspiration syndrome, birth trauma, respiratory distress syndrome, necrotizing enterocolitis, neonatal infection)
cohort: Nulliparous women who delivered a term singleton infant
finding: An intervention at a Chinese maternity hospital led to a significant reduction in cesarean delivery rates, particularly non-indicated antepartum CD, without negatively impacting neonatal outcomes.
